1.season_normalization: Separate actual/Potential centers; shared season PF SD

potential_points.validation: 2023 selection; rolling 2024-2025 holdout; residual downward bias remains

1.description: Quarterly and Reg Season forecasts estimate team scoring ability from bye- and injury-adjusted Potential PPG using Empirical-Bayes estimates trained on normalized seasons beginning in 2018. The simulations include Normal-inverse-Gaussian weekly scoring variation and week-specific uncertainty about team strength. Bonus Games and Playoffs share these Bonus Game forecasts.
